content.short: Quarry is an open protocol for initiating Solana liquidity mining programs.
content.description: Quarry Protocol provides an open framework to launch Solana liquidity mining programs. It was created to help Solana projects establish on-chain liquidity mining initiatives, replacing the current practice of manual token transfers with a scalable on-chain solution. By enabling on-chain, composable, and enforceable liquidity mining, Quarry aims to accelerate ecosystem growth and make incentive programs more reliable for projects across the Solana ecosystem.
